about_the_game:
Humans are weak! You can’t go anywhere without your STRANGER MAIDENS!

【Game System】

Not like your typical Roguelike Survivor, this game focuses on an innovative Squad Based Combat System. Adept to various challenges with a diverse cast of Stranger Maidens, build your ultimate team to eliminate your foes.

Whether you want to minmax your way to success, or you just want to hangout with your favourite girl, “Stranger Maidens” will provide you with a satisfying experience.

【Story】

You play as Joey, a loser who was traumatised by the loss of his father. One day you received a mysterious artefact left by your father, and you are determined to go on an adventure to find out what happened to him.

In your journey you will encounter a variety of beautiful yet mysterious Strangers Maidens, each with their own story to tell. Combining their combat prowess and the strange power of the artefact, you come closer to the truth with every step…

【Feature】

  • Tactical Squad Based Combat System provides many possibilities in every battle.

  • Powerful upgrades await your discovery.

  • Traditional RPG narration style, you get stories both in and out of combat.

  • 19 uniquely designed story stages, no more repetitive gameplay.

  • 6 Stranger Maidens each with their own story and unique charm.

  • All sex scenes are fully hand drawn and fully animated.

【Stranger Maidens】

  • Shu’Rah

    Barbarian warrior of the Northern Highland. With combat ferocity as explosive as her temperament, she is a reliable companion who is to be admired and feared.

    In Combat, Shu’Rah uses her exceptional physique to stand between the enemies and her team, keeping all dangers away from her teammates.

  • Alith

    An elite huntress from the Underground. She might appear to be sweet and naive, but she is hiding some secrets…
    Her mastercraft crossbow allows her to sniper enemies from afar, and her wolf and traps can effectively weaken her prey.

  • Jezerin

    The seductive Demon mage. Despite her diabolical appearance, she has a very gentle soul, and the only thing she has to match her look is her exceptional horniness.

    In the battlefield she weaves destructive fire magics, burning all enemies to crisp in a blink of an eye.

  • Bo

    Also known as Black Orchid the Flying Thief, Bo is a femme fatale haunted by bad blood, and she has absolutely no time for bullshits.

    Her proficiency with throwing weapons allows her to perform a wide variety of attacks, not to mention she is very familiar with using poison.

  • Shanni

    A Goblin Shaman who lives alone in the swamp. Despite having the wisdom of a thousand ancestors by her side, she is an absolute nightmare to hangout with due to her toxicity.

    Her sorcery allows her to put curses on a large area, sucking the life out of everything that dares to linger.

  • Kiritsuki

    An honorable Lizard swordsman from a far away Empire, she is on a suicide mission to hunt down a murderous fiend who slaughtered all her kins.

    Do not be fooled by her elegance, her swordsmanship is a truly deadly art, able to dish out terrible damage in a flash.
